method_limits: Control first; reversed confirmation remains outstanding.
Successful latencies exclude refused requests; any timed error fails qualification.
Operation durations overlap and are not additive client latency components.
Gathering frames ends queue residence earlier and transfers physical write time into exchange timing; lower queue means alone do not establish a client improvement.
Boundary VM/cgroup counters differ in timing and cannot be exactly subtracted.
Coverage index distance includes protocol entries; boundary lag is not admission retained-entry count.

Before both timed cohorts, stopped historical volumes were copied with full content/metadata verification into the existing external mount; original Docker volume paths and contents remain. One control preflight stopped at the 5-GiB internal reserve before creating a fleet or issuing writes.
decision: Revert gathered control writes: neither cohort qualifies and no throughput benefit is established. Retain the existing per-reply sliding eight-frame window.
